dedupe_keys.name: synthetic indoor climate and occupancy data from office and meeting room simulations

description: The Coddora researchers publish synthetic indoor-climate and occupancy series generated with EnergyPlus. Zenodo supplies office and meeting-room HDF5 archives and occupancy CSVs under CC BY 4.0. The description reports one million simulated days from one hundred thousand randomised room configurations. Channels include one-minute occupancy, carbon dioxide, window state and simulation metadata. These series can train or stress-test occupancy-detection and ventilation-control components before applying them to real buildings. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this synthetic corpus. Coverage is the sampled office and meeting-room assumptions, not field observations from one million independent buildings. A limitation is that randomisation ranges and EnergyPlus schedules determine what behaviours the learner sees; transfer to actual occupancy or ventilation faults is not established by dataset size. The supplied CSVs describe simulated sequences, while model setup details are in metadata. No HDF5 file was downloaded or synthetic distribution independently checked.
